name: NYU Depth v2
attrs: Normals derived from Kinect depth; canonical indoor monocular normal benchmark.

name: SUN RGB-D
attrs: Depth-derived normals across diverse indoor scenes and sensors.

name: ScanNet
attrs: Mesh- or depth-derived normals with camera trajectories; useful for video and reconstruction-linked supervision.

name: Matterport3D
attrs: High-resolution reconstructed geometry; supports room-scale and panoramic normal evaluation.

name: Taskonomy
attrs: Large multi-task supervision including surface normals, depth, reshading, and semantics.

name: Replica
attrs: Clean normals from high-quality reconstructed scenes; useful for controlled evaluation.

name: DIODE
attrs: Depth-derived normals; stresses cross-domain generalization beyond NYU-style indoor scenes.

name: Hypersim
attrs: Ground-truth depth, normals, materials, and lighting for geometry + intrinsic learning.

name: Omnidata
attrs: Large-scale mid-level vision training data with normals and many related tasks.

name: KITTI Odometry
attrs: Classical and learned VO; segment drift evaluation.

name: TUM RGB-D
attrs: Indoor RGB-D SLAM and trajectory accuracy.

name: Cambridge Landmarks
attrs: Outdoor absolute pose regression and relocalization.

name: ScanNet
attrs: Learned pose, reconstruction, and dense geometry.

name: MegaDepth
attrs: Relative pose, matching, depth, and geometric pretraining.

name: RealEstate10K
attrs: Self-supervised video geometry and view synthesis.

name: Virtual KITTI 2
attrs: Controlled sim-to-real VO and depth evaluation.

name: BOP Challenge
attrs: Unified protocol over LM-O, T-LESS, YCB-V, ITODD, IC-BIN, TUD-L, HB, HOPE

name: MichiganIndoorCorridor
attrs: Ground + three walls on first frame

name: KITTI Scene Flow 2015
attrs: Sparse disparity (tt, t+1t{+}1) + flow from LiDAR and CAD fits

name: TartanAir
attrs: Dense depth, flow, pose; indoor and outdoor, weather

name: TVR
attrs: 21.8k clips (60–90 s) from 6 TV shows; 109k queries

name: AV-SELD
attrs: F-score, error rate, DOA error, distance error

name: REC / RES
